title: Dasher Analytics Event Schema v1
description: Published openly at https://github.com/dasher-project/Dasher-Windows. If it's not in this schema, it's not collected. All Dasher frontends (Windows, Apple, GTK) share the same PostHog project — events are distinguished by the default properties below.

default_properties.description: Automatically appended to every event from every frontend

$os.description: The posthog-dotnet SDK sends no $os context, so it is set explicitly — keeps OS breakdowns consistent with the Apple/Android SDKs.

$geoip_disable.description: Sent on every event (including crashes): PostHog Cloud must not derive location from the client IP (RFC 0001: no location data).

analytics_id_reset.description: User reset their anonymous analytics ID

stack_trace.note: May contain file paths but not user text

exception_type.note: Original exception type name; set explicitly on deferred reports where the SDK's native typing names the SavedCrashException wrapper instead (#60)

source.note: Where the exception was caught (e.g. Program.Main)

engine_log_tail.note: Deferred reports only: last engine diagnostic lines captured with the crash

ui_action.description: RFC 0001 2026-10-28 amendment: the user activated a control in the main UI (anything outside the settings windows). Opt-in gated like every event.

surface.description: ime_toolbar = the keyboard (direct-entry) mode mini-bar. status_bar also covers the bottom message-pane header (speak / copy / new / paste / enter-direct-mode controls). The RFC's ime_topbar surface has no Windows equivalent and is therefore never emitted.

action.description: Fixed vocabulary; new identifiers require a schema update. select_all: retained for historical events, no emitter since #80 (mini-bar button removed)

state.description: Toggles (direct_mode, game_mode, control_mode, hide) carry on/off; the layout action carries the pane position. For select actions: "dist=<char|word|paragraph|all>,forward=<yes|no>".

setting_changed.description: RFC 0001 2026-10-28 amendment: the user committed a settings change at the widget site. Programmatic changes (engine init, defaults, migrations) never emit this.

setting_id.description: Canonical identifier: the DasherCore parameter display name (e.g. Max Speed (bits/sec)) or the frontend setting key (e.g. output_font_size, access_method). Locale caveat: engine parameter display names follow the UI locale (RFC 0003), so the same setting may report under its translated name — frontend keys are locale-stable. Speech engine credentials are deliberately excluded (secrets).

value.description: Present only for bool/number/enum values from a fixed vocabulary. OMITTED for string settings - free text is never collected

surface.description: Where the change was made. Windows currently emits settings and main_ui only

explicitly_not_collected: User name, email, or account info
Values of free-text/string settings (2026-10-28 amendment: only the fact that such a setting changed is collected)
File paths of any kind (2026-10-28 amendment)
